looks_wrong.what: The 'Revise a topic' card lists Biology · Chemistry · Physics · Geography · Sociology but not Maths, even though Maths is the subject she is using.
Same subject list without Maths on the laptop home card.
After coming back, the home 'Revise a topic' card still omits Maths, while the resume card directly above it says Maths.

would_quit.quote: Step 2: "Calculate the flour needed." — the student gives up here and leaves the question unfinished.
would_quit.why: Fifth question in a row is a 3-step, 3-mark recipe question. A bored 15-year-old with 6 questions still to go and no sense of score or reward taps Home.

fixes.target: Home page 'Revise a topic' card subject list
fixes.change: Add Maths to the list, e.g. 'Maths · Biology · Chemistry · Physics · Geography · Sociology'.
Show marks so far, e.g. 'Marks so far: 6/7'. Also show a short note on how many questions are left to the 80% badge, so there is a visible reason to push on.
Make the step concrete and short to lower the effort: 'Flour: 300 g × 2.5 = ? g'. Or show the scale factor 2.5 inline in the prompt.
Replace the generic 'Not quite — check your working' with a targeted line, e.g. 'k = y ÷ x. Use y = 24 and x = 8.'

checks.what: coming back resumes the same test question
